title: Assessing how Ethereum’s 2027 upgrade could redefine ETH’s utility
summary: Ethereum’s stablecoin-driven fee model could reshape ETH demand and fuel its next DeFi cycle.
content: An upcoming Ethereum upgrade projected for 2027 is drawing attention for its potential to redefine the network's utility. Analysts suggest that a stablecoin-driven fee model could significantly reshape demand for ETH and help fuel the next major decentralized finance cycle.

title: Visa and Revolut carry out passkey-based agentic payment in France
summary: Revolut and Visa have carried out the first passkey-authenticated agentic card payment in France.
content: Revolut and Visa have successfully completed the first passkey-authenticated agentic card payment in France. This milestone achievement combines advanced passkey security technology with agentic payment capabilities, marking a significant step forward for digital transactions and authentication methods in the French market.

title: Nasdaq, Börse Stuttgart and others urge EU to rethink €100bn DLT cap
summary: Nasdaq and Börse Stuttgart Group are among the market infrastructure players calling on European lawmakers to rethink a planned €100 billion DLT Pilot Regime cap.
content: Nasdaq, Börse Stuttgart Group, and other market infrastructure players are calling on European lawmakers to reconsider a planned €100 billion cap under the DLT Pilot Regime. The coalition is urging the European Union to rethink these regulatory limits to better support the growth and testing of distributed ledger technology within European financial markets.
